summary: Fighting erupted at 2:15 PM in the Phu Pha Lek-Phlan Hin Paed Kon area, Kantharalak District, Si Sa Ket Province. Cambodian forces reportedly opened fire with recoilless rifles, prompting a heavy response from the Thai military. The Second Army Region (Suranaree Task Force) issued an urgent alert for civilians in four border provinces—Si Sa Ket, Surin, Buriram, and Ubon Ratchathani—to move to designated bomb shelters and temporary relief centers.

summary: The Thai government is accelerating aid for farmers to evacuate livestock due to the border clash, with over 5.5 million animals—including cattle, buffalo, swine, and 4.7 million poultry—affected across six border provinces. 432 animals have been reported dead or missing. The Department of Livestock Development is providing emergency supplies like hay and pet food, and assisting with evacuations.
summaryEn: The Thai government is accelerating aid for farmers to evacuate livestock due to the border clash, with over 5.5 million animals—including cattle, buffalo, swine, and 4.7 million poultry—affected across six border provinces. 432 animals have been reported dead or missing. The Department of Livestock Development is providing emergency supplies like hay and pet food, and assisting with evacuations.

summary: Officials from the Joint Press Centre on the Thailand-Cambodia Border Situation stated that all military operations are being conducted in compliance with international humanitarian law and the right to self-defense under Article 51 of the UN Charter. The military rejected accusations from Hun Sen that Thailand was the aggressor, asserting that Cambodian forces initiated unprovoked gunfire and heavy assaults on civilian areas.

The military rejected accusations from Hun Sen that Thailand was the aggressor, asserting that Cambodian forces initiated unprovoked gunfire and heavy assaults on civilian areas.
summaryKh: មន្ត្រីមជ្ឈមណ្ឌលសារព័ត៌មានរួមស្តីពីស្ថានភាពព្រំដែនថៃ-កម្ពុជា បានថ្លែងថា រាល់ប្រតិបត្តិការយោធាទាំងអស់ត្រូវបានធ្វើឡើងដោយអនុលោមតាមច្បាប់មនុស្សធម៌អន្តរជាតិ និងសិទ្ធិការពារខ្លួនក្រោមមាត្រា 51 នៃធម្មនុញ្ញសហប្រជាជាតិ។ យោធាបានបដិសេធការចោទប្រកាន់របស់លោក ហ៊ុន សែន ដែលថាថៃជាអ្នកឈ្លានពាន ដោយអះអាងថាកងកម្លាំងកម្ពុជាបានចាប់ផ្តើមការបាញ់ប្រហារ និងការវាយប្រហារយ៉ាងខ្លាំងក្លាលើតំបន់ស៊ីវិលមុន។
summaryTh: เจ้าหน้าที่จากศูนย์แถลงข่าวร่วมสถานการณ์ชายแดนไทย-กัมพูชา ระบุว่าปฏิบัติการทางทหารทั้งหมดดำเนินการตามกฎหมายมนุษยธรรมระหว่างประเทศและสิทธิในการป้องกันตนเองภายใต้มาตรา 51 ของกฎบัตรสหประชาชาติ กองทัพปฏิเสธข้อกล่าวหาของฮุน เซน ที่ว่าไทยเป็นฝ่ายรุกราน โดยยืนยันว่ากองกำลังกัมพูชาเป็นฝ่ายเริ่มยิงและโจมตีพื้นที่พลเรือนก่อน

summary: The 2nd Army Area Command reported that Thai forces successfully captured strategic objectives at Chong Khana and Chong Rayi-Preu. The report also noted that Cambodian forces fired BM-21 rockets into civilian areas in Surin and used drones to drop 82mm mortar rounds at Chong An Ma.

summary: Bangkok Commercial Asset Management (BAM) announced a debt relief measure for soldiers, police, and medical personnel affected by the border conflict. summary: The Royal Thai Army Region 2 Command reported on the ongoing border situation (as of Dec 11), claiming that retaliatory actions by the Thai military had resulted in the deaths of 102 Cambodian soldiers, the destruction of 6 T-55 tanks, one BM-21 rocket launcher, and 64 drone systems. The report also details the significant humanitarian impact, with over 220,000 Thai civilians evacuated across four provinces.

The report also details the significant humanitarian impact, with over 220,000 Thai civilians evacuated across four provinces.

summary: The 1st Army Area Command reports intense fighting on the border, where Cambodian forces are using BM-21 rockets and drones in an attempt to retake Ban Nong Ya Kaeo. Thai forces successfully destroyed a Cambodian arms depot near Ban Chok Chey. Thai authorities are also trying to coordinate with Cambodia to repatriate Thai citizens from Poipet, but the Cambodian side has not responded for two days. The total number of Thai military casualties since December 8th is 1 dead (due to illness) and many injuries.

summary: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul made a forceful statement after his phone call with US President Donald Trump, clarifying that he merely updated Trump on the border situation and did not agree to a ceasefire. summary: This investigative report tracks the timeline of the collapse of the ceasefire. On Dec 7, small arms fire was reported at 2:15 PM and again at 8:02 PM in the Choam Kasant area near Preah Vihear. Col. Winthai Suvaree, Army Spokesman, confirmed that Thai forces acted according to rules of engagement after Cambodian provocations. The report highlights the conflicting narratives, with Cambodia claiming no response to maintain peace, while Thai intelligence monitored heavy troop movements.

summary: The Royal Thai Air Force used two F-16 fighter jets to destroy the Chum Nea bridge in Cambodia's Pursat province early Saturday morning. This action was a response to reports from the Thai navy about ongoing Cambodian military reinforcements near the Trat province sector of the border. The bridge was identified as a critical logistics route for Cambodian troops, and fighting continues in the area.

summary: Thailand's 2nd Army Area reports recovering a notebook, purportedly from the Cambodian military, after clashes in Ubon Ratchathani. The notebook allegedly contains coordinates and maps showing records of laying 30 explosives in 11 locations on August 12 and plans for six additional mine-laying locations on August 21. The Thai military is using this as evidence that Cambodia is laying new mines. Skirmishes continue, with Cambodian forces still firing BM-21 rockets.

The notebook allegedly contains coordinates and maps showing records of laying 30 explosives in 11 locations on August 12 and plans for six additional mine-laying locations on August 21. The Thai military is using this as evidence that Cambodia is laying new mines. Skirmishes continue, with Cambodian forces still firing BM-21 rockets.

summary: The 1st Army Area Operations Center summarized the Dec 13, 2025, situation along the border in Sa Kaeo province. Key operations included maneuvering and using fire support to control areas in Ta Phraya and Khok Sung districts. Cambodian forces continuously retaliated with BM-21 rockets and artillery. The report confirmed that the cumulative number of injured Thai soldiers is 48, and Cambodian forces are still holding captive Thai citizens, marking the third day of their detention.

summary: Fighting has continued despite US President Donald Trump's claim to have brokered a ceasefire. Cambodia alleges Thai forces, including fighter jets, are still striking targets, while Thailand's military counters that Cambodia is violating international rules by targeting civilian locations. Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul did not confirm a ceasefire, stating that Cambodia was the violator, leaving Thailand no choice but to defend its people and sovereignty.

Cambodia alleges Thai forces, including fighter jets, are still striking targets, while Thailand's military counters that Cambodia is violating international rules by targeting civilian locations. summary: The Ministry of Defence Spokesperson, Rear Admiral Surasant Kongsiri, reported on December 13 that continuous clashes are occurring along all 7 border provinces, with Cambodia's non-selective attacks affecting civilians. He added that many injured soldiers have volunteered to return to the front line.

He added that many injured soldiers have volunteered to return to the front line.

summary: Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow expressed deep disappointment with US President Donald Trump’s remarks on the border situation, stating they were based on misinformation. He specifically rejected Trump's description of landmine explosions that injured Thai soldiers as “roadside accidents,” presenting evidence that Cambodia had laid new landmines. The Minister also rejected claims that Thailand's military response was excessive, insisting it was proportionate and defensive.

summary: Caretaker Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul reiterated Thailand's official stance, stating there is no ceasefire agreement with Cambodia and that the Thai military will continue fighting on the border. He was responding to a call by Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim for a cessation of hostilities and stressed that Cambodia must submit a formal proposal and fully cease all hostility first. He added that focusing on external statements would distract Thailand from its responsibility to protect its sovereignty and people, especially after Cambodian rocket attacks injured civilians.

summary: US President Donald Trump announced on his Truth Social platform that following a phone call with Thai PM Anutin Charnvirakul and Cambodian PM Hun Manet, both leaders agreed to 'cease all firing' and return to the previous peace agreement. Trump also thanked Malaysian PM Anwar Ibrahim for his assistance.

source: ไทยรัฐออนไลน์ (Thai Rath)
summary: Citing a BBC report, the article states that Cambodia's Interior Ministry ordered the indefinite closure of the border with Thailand as fighting continues. Cambodia alleges that Thai fighter jets attacked a hotel. The report also mentions that the renewed fighting has caused over 700,000 people to be evacuated from both sides of the border. It also covers the differing Thai and Cambodian responses to President Trump's announced ceasefire.
summaryEn: Citing a BBC report, the article states that Cambodia's Interior Ministry ordered the indefinite closure of the border with Thailand as fighting continues. Cambodia alleges that Thai fighter jets attacked a hotel. The report also mentions that the renewed fighting has caused over 700,000 people to be evacuated from both sides of the border. It also covers the differing Thai and Cambodian responses to President Trump's announced ceasefire.
summaryKh: អត្ថបទនេះសំអាងលើរបាយការណ៍ BBC ថា ក្រសួងមហាផ្ទៃកម្ពុជាបានបញ្ជាឱ្យបិទព្រំដែនជាមួយថៃដោយគ្មានកំណត់ ដោយសារតែការប្រយុទ្ធគ្នានៅតែបន្ត។ កម្ពុជាអះអាងថា យន្តហោះចម្បាំងថៃបានវាយប្រហារសណ្ឋាគារមួយ ប៉ុន្តែថៃក៏បានរាយការណ៍ពីរបួសរបស់ជនស៊ីវិលដោយសារគ្រាប់រ៉ុក្កែតកម្ពុជាដែរ។ របាយការណ៍នេះក៏លើកឡើងផងដែរថា ការប្រយុទ្ធគ្នានេះបណ្តាលឱ្យមនុស្សជាង 700,000 នាក់ត្រូវបានជម្លៀសចេញពីតំបន់ព្រំដែនទាំងសងខាង។
summaryTh: บทความอ้างรายงานจาก BBC ว่ากระทรวงมหาดไทยกัมพูชาสั่งปิดชายแดนติดไทยแบบไม่มีกำหนดเพราะการสู้รบยังต่อเนื่อง กัมพูชาอ้างว่าเครื่องบินรบไทยโจมตีโรงแรม แต่ไทยก็รายงานว่ามีพลเรือนบาดเจ็บจากจรวดกัมพูชา ข่าวระบุว่าทหารไทยเสียชีวิตรวม 15 นาย บาดเจ็บ 270 นาย และพลเรือน 6 นาย ขณะที่ประชาชนกว่า 700,000 คนต้องอพยพออกจากพื้นที่ชายแดน

summary: Rangsiman Rome, a former MP and political figure, advised the Thai Foreign Ministry to take a more proactive and aggressive diplomatic strategy to 'isolate Cambodia' on the world stage. He argued that the Foreign Ministry must communicate clearly that Cambodia initiated the border conflict, which he claimed is an attempt by Cambodia to shift focus away from the ongoing issue of scammer groups and illegal 'grey capital' operating along the border.
summaryEn: Rangsiman Rome, a former MP and political figure, advised the Thai Foreign Ministry to take a more proactive and aggressive diplomatic strategy to 'isolate Cambodia' on the world stage. He argued that the Foreign Ministry must communicate clearly that Cambodia initiated the border conflict, which he claimed is an attempt by Cambodia to shift focus away from the ongoing issue of scammer groups and illegal 'grey capital' operating along the border.
summaryKh: លោក រ៉ាំងស៊ីម៉ាន់ រ៉ូម អតីតតំណាងរាស្រ្ត និងជាអ្នកនយោបាយ បានណែនាំឱ្យក្រសួងការបរទេសថៃប្រើប្រាស់យុទ្ធសាស្រ្តការទូតយ៉ាងសកម្ម និងខ្លាំងក្លា ដើម្បី 'ញែកកម្ពុជាឱ្យនៅដាច់ដោយឡែក' ពីគេនៅលើឆាកអន្តរជាតិ។ លោកលើកឡើងថា ក្រសួងការបរទេសត្រូវតែផ្សព្វផ្សាយឱ្យពិភពលោកយល់ថា កម្ពុជាជាអ្នកបង្កជម្លោះព្រំដែននេះឡើង ដើម្បីបង្វែរចំណាប់អារម្មណ៍ពីបញ្ហាក្រុមបោកប្រាស់ (Scammers) និងដើមទុនប្រផេះ (Grey Capital) ដែលកំពុងប្រតិបត្តិការនៅតាមព្រំដែន។
summaryTh: นายรังสิมันต์ โรม อดีต ส.ส. และนักการเมือง แนะนำให้กระทรวงการต่างประเทศของไทยใช้ยุทธศาสตร์การทูตที่เชิงรุกมากขึ้น เพื่อ 'โดดเดี่ยว' กัมพูชาในเวทีโลก โดยระบุว่า กต. ต้องสื่อสารให้ทั่วโลกเข้าใจว่ากัมพูชาเป็นฝ่ายจุดชนวนความขัดแย้งชายแดน เพื่อกลบเกลื่อนปัญหาแก๊งสแกมเมอร์และทุนเทาตามแนวชายแดน

summary: The Thai military reported a total of 15 Thai soldiers killed and over 270 injured in the border clashes. Border Patrol Police (BPP) are focusing on anti-espionage and anti-drone measures along the border.
summaryEn: The Thai military reported a total of 15 Thai soldiers killed and over 270 injured in the border clashes. The report confirmed the successful destruction of Cambodian heavy equipment and military targets, claiming a high number of Cambodian soldier fatalities (181). Border Patrol Police (BPP) are focusing on anti-espionage and anti-drone measures. The Army also stated that Cambodia's use of ancient ruins as a military base renders the area unprotected under the Hague Convention.

summary: Mr. Prapas Sonchaidee, Director of the Thai-Cambodian Border Situation Joint Press Center, stated that any ceasefire agreement must be mutually agreed upon by Thailand and Cambodia, and importantly, the security situation on the ground must be assessed first. The statement emphasizes that Thailand did not initiate the violence, acts in self-defense, and is committed to protecting its citizens. He also mentioned that the government remains fully operational despite the House dissolution.

The statement emphasizes that Thailand did not initiate the violence, acts in self-defense, and is committed to protecting its citizens. He also mentioned that the government remains fully operational despite the House dissolution.
summaryKh: លោកប្រភាស សនចៃឌី នាយកមជ្ឈមណ្ឌលសារព័ត៌មានរួមទទួលបន្ទុកស្ថានភាពព្រំដែនថៃ-កម្ពុជា បានថ្លែងថា ការព្រមព្រៀងឈប់បាញ់ណាមួយ ត្រូវតែជាការព្រមព្រៀងគ្នាទៅវិញទៅមករវាងថៃនិងកម្ពុជា ហើយសំខាន់ត្រូវតែវាយតម្លៃស្ថានភាពសន្តិសុខនៅសមរភូមិជាក់ស្តែងជាមុនសិន។ សេចក្តីថ្លែងការណ៍នេះសង្កត់ធ្ងន់ថា ថៃមិនមែនជាអ្នកចាប់ផ្តើមអំពើហិង្សាទេ គឺធ្វើដើម្បីការពារខ្លួនតាមច្បាប់អន្តរជាតិ និងប្តេជ្ញាការពារប្រជាពលរដ្ឋខ្លួន។ គាត់ក៏បានលើកឡើងដែរថា រដ្ឋាភិបាលថៃនៅតែបន្តដំណើរការពេញលេញ ទោះបីមានការរំលាយសភាក៏ដោយ។

source: ไทยรัฐ Thai Rath
summary: The Joint Press Center for the Thailand-Cambodia Border Situation, led by the Ministry of Defence Spokesperson, issued a statement on December 14, denying Cambodia's claim of a ceasefire. Thailand affirmed that it continues to face heavy, sustained BM-21 rocket and artillery attacks from Cambodia, necessitating ongoing self-defense operations. The statement also condemned Cambodia's action of blocking Thai and foreign nationals from exiting the country via land crossings.
summaryEn: The Joint Press Center, led by the Ministry of Defence Spokesperson, issued a statement on December 14, denying Cambodia's claim of a ceasefire. Thailand affirmed that it continues to face heavy, sustained BM-21 rocket and artillery attacks from Cambodia, necessitating ongoing self-defense operations. The statement also condemned Cambodia's action of blocking Thai and foreign nationals from exiting the country via land crossings, calling it a clear violation of international human rights law.
summaryKh: មជ្ឈមណ្ឌលសារព័ត៌មានរួម បានចេញសេចក្តីថ្លែងការណ៍កាលពីថ្ងៃទី 14 ខែធ្នូ ដោយបដិសេធការអះអាងរបស់កម្ពុជាអំពីបទឈប់បាញ់។ ភាគីថៃបញ្ជាក់ថា ខ្លួននៅតែប្រឈមមុខនឹងការវាយប្រហារដោយកាំជ្រួច BM-21 និងកាំភ្លើងធំពីកម្ពុជាជាបន្តបន្ទាប់ ដែលតម្រូវឱ្យមានប្រតិបត្តិការការពារខ្លួន។ សេចក្តីថ្លែងការណ៍នេះក៏បានថ្កោលទោសសកម្មភាពរបស់កម្ពុជាក្នុងការរារាំងប្រជាជនថៃ និងជនបរទេសមិនឱ្យចាកចេញពីប្រទេសតាមផ្លូវគោក។
summaryTh: ศูนย์แถลงข่าวร่วมฯ นำโดยโฆษกกระทรวงกลาโหม แถลงเมื่อวันที่ 14 ธันวาคม ปฏิเสธการอ้างเรื่องหยุดยิงของกัมพูชา ยืนยันว่าไทยยังคงถูกระดมยิงด้วยจรวด BM-21 และปืนใหญ่อย่างต่อเนื่อง ทำให้ไทยจำเป็นต้องป้องกันตนเอง พร้อมทั้งประณามการที่กัมพูชาระงับการเดินทางออกนอกประเทศทางบกของคนไทยและชาวต่างชาติ โดยชี้ว่าเป็นการละเมิดกฎหมายสิทธิมนุษยชนระหว่างประเทศอย่างชัดเจน

summary: Thai Army Region 2 (AR2) reported the latest situation in the border clash, stating that fighting in the Ta Kwai area remains intense with both direct-fire and indirect-fire weapons, including drone attacks. AR2 claims that Thai forces successfully destroyed 48 enemy targets, including 10 tanks, 64 drones, and various military and 'scammer' bases, with a reported 181 Cambodian soldiers killed.
summaryEn: Thai Army Region 2 (AR2) reported the latest situation in the border clash, stating that fighting in the Ta Kwai area remains intense with both direct-fire and indirect-fire weapons, including drone attacks. AR2 claims that Thai forces successfully destroyed 48 enemy targets, including 10 tanks, 64 drones, and various military and 'scammer' bases, with a reported 181 Cambodian soldiers killed.
summaryKh: កងទ័ពភាគទី 2 (AR2) បានរាយការណ៍ពីស្ថានការណ៍ប៉ះទង្គិចព្រំដែនចុងក្រោយថា ការប្រយុទ្ធនៅតំបន់តាខ្វាយនៅតែខ្លាំងក្លា ដោយប្រើប្រាស់អាវុធបាញ់ចំ និងបាញ់កោង រួមទាំងការវាយប្រហារដោយដ្រូន។ AR2 អះអាងថា កម្លាំងថៃបានបំផ្លាញគោលដៅសត្រូវ 48 កន្លែង រួមទាំងរថក្រោះ 10 គ្រឿង ដ្រូន 64 គ្រឿង និងមូលដ្ឋានយោធានិង 'មូលដ្ឋានស្គែមម័រ' (Scammer) ជាច្រើនកន្លែង ដោយមានរបាយការណ៍ថាទាហានកម្ពុជាស្លាប់ 181 នាក់។
summaryTh: กองทัพภาคที่ 2 (ทภ.2) รายงานสถานการณ์ปะทะล่าสุดว่า การรบในพื้นที่ตาควายยังหนักมาก ทั้งการใช้อาวุธยิงตรงและยิงโค้ง รวมถึงโดรนโจมตี ทภ.2 อ้างว่าฝ่ายไทยทำลายเป้าหมายข้าศึกสำเร็จไป 48 แห่ง เช่น รถถัง 10 คัน โดรน 64 ลำ ฐานทหารและฐาน 'แก๊งคอลเซ็นเตอร์' หลายจุด พร้อมระบุว่าทหารกัมพูชาเสียชีวิต 181 นาย.

summary: The Joint Press Center for the Thai-Cambodian Border Situation (Thai government body) issued a statement confirming that Thailand has not agreed to a ceasefire, despite a 'third party' (referencing Donald Trump's claim) intervening. They insist that any decision to stop fighting must be based on a security assessment on the ground to ensure the safety of citizens and personnel.

They insist that any decision to stop fighting must be based on a security assessment on the ground to ensure the safety of citizens and personnel.

summary: The Royal Thai Army (RTA) spokesperson confirmed on December 14, 2025, that there is no plan for a ceasefire until Cambodia stops its hostile actions, as attacks are still ongoing. The RTA stated it would not release the 18 captured Cambodian soldiers, adding that they are being treated in accordance with international law, and their release is conditioned on Cambodia ceasing aggression, including the continued use of landmines and BM-21 rockets against Thai territory.
summaryEn: The Royal Thai Army (RTA) spokesperson confirmed on December 14, 2025, that there is no plan for a ceasefire until Cambodia stops its hostile actions, as attacks are still ongoing. The RTA stated it would not release the 18 captured Cambodian soldiers, adding that they are being treated in accordance with international law, and their release is conditioned on Cambodia ceasing aggression, including the continued use of landmines and BM-21 rockets against Thai territory.

summary: Clashes in Surin province continued for the eighth day, with heavy fighting overnight, and Cambodian forces using suicide and bomb-dropping drones near Prasat Ta Kwai. Separately, Nakhon Ratchasima (Korat) police received intelligence about foreign mercenaries (allegedly Russian, hired by Cambodia) potentially residing in the area with the aim of using drones to attack strategic sites, specifically mentioning Air Force Base 1. The Russian Embassy later issued a statement denying the mercenary claims.

summary: Report on the Royal Thai Marine Corps' operation on the morning of December 14 to reclaim 'Ban Sam Lang' in Trat province, a strategically important area that Cambodia had reportedly been using as a base to gather forces, store armaments, and launch heavy artillery, which posed a threat to Thai citizens and soldiers. The operation was launched to ensure border security and restore safe living conditions for local residents.
summaryEn: The Royal Thai Marine Corps launched an operation on the morning of December 14 to reclaim 'Ban Sam Lang' in Trat province. The report highlights the strategic importance of this area, which Cambodia had allegedly used to gather forces, store armaments, and launch heavy artillery attacks against Thai citizens and soldiers. The military confirmed the successful reclamation and planting of the Thai flag, stating the action was necessary to ensure security and restore safe living conditions for residents.

summary: The article summarizes the casualty figures in the Thailand-Cambodia border conflict, reporting 16 Thai soldiers killed and 327 injured. summary: The Thai Army Region 2 Command reported that the Thailand-Cambodia border situation remains highly tense with continuous clashes overnight. The Cambodian side has escalated its use of force by reinforcing artillery and BM-21 rockets in several areas, with UAVs and FPV drones also continuously detected. Thai forces responded by firing artillery, which successfully destroyed one Cambodian truck.

summary: The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) stated a 4-point position expressing grave concern over Cambodia's decision to suspend all land border crossings, which prevents Thai citizens from returning home, while Thailand had facilitated the return of Cambodian citizens. The MFA emphasized that the action violates international law and humanitarian principles, and stressed the importance of protecting civilians and diplomatic access. Thailand affirmed its actions are purely self-defense and not aimed at seeking conflict.

Thailand affirmed its actions are purely self-defense and not aimed at seeking conflict.

summary: The Thai military announced it has stopped fuel shipments passing through a border checkpoint with Laos, out of concern that the fuel was being diverted to Cambodia during the intense border conflict. Additionally, a scheduled special meeting of ASEAN foreign ministers has been postponed to December 22 at Thailand's request.

Additionally, a scheduled special meeting of ASEAN foreign ministers has been postponed to December 22 at Thailand's request.

summary: The Ministry of Defence Spokesperson confirmed that the Thai military has successfully pushed Cambodian forces out and now has 100% control of the Ta Kwai Temple (Prasat Ta Kwai), which is within Thai territory. The statement also refuted two Cambodian 'fake news' claims: that Cambodian troops still control the temple and a claim that Thai casualties exceeded 1,000, which used an AI-generated image.
summaryEn: The Ministry of Defence Spokesperson confirmed that the Thai military has successfully pushed Cambodian forces out and now has 100% control of the Ta Kwai Temple (Prasat Ta Kwai), which is within Thai territory. The statement also refuted two Cambodian 'fake news' claims: that Cambodian troops still control the temple and a claim that Thai casualties exceeded 1,000, which used an AI-generated image.

summary: The President of the Trat Hotel and Resort Association revealed that foreign tourist bookings have been canceled by 40% following the recent fighting in Trat province. The association is concerned that the prolonged situation will severely affect the local tourism business.
summaryEn: The President of the Trat Hotel and Resort Association revealed that foreign tourist bookings have been canceled by 40% following the recent fighting in Trat province. The association is concerned that the prolonged situation will severely affect the local tourism business.

summaryTh: นายกสมาคมโรงแรมและรีสอร์ท จ.ตราด เปิดเผยว่า ยอดจองของนักท่องเที่ยวต่างชาติถูกยกเลิกไปแล้ว 40% หลังเกิดเหตุสู้รบในพื้นที่ จ.ตราด โดยกังวลว่าสถานการณ์ที่ยืดเยื้อจะส่งผลกระทบต่อธุรกิจท่องเที่ยวในพื้นที่อย่างรุนแรง

source: กรุงเทพธุรกิจ Bangkok Biz News
summary: The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) spokesperson outlined three conditions for a ceasefire with Cambodia: 1) Cambodia must announce a ceasefire first. 2) The ceasefire must be real and continuous. 3) Cambodia must genuinely cooperate in clearing landmines. The MFA also stated that Thailand had informed the UN Human Rights Office about Cambodia's alleged violations, emphasizing that Cambodia initiated the attack, causing Thai military and civilian casualties and forcing the closure of over 600 schools/hospitals.
summaryEn: The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) spokesperson outlined three conditions for a ceasefire with Cambodia: 1) Cambodia must announce a ceasefire first. 2) The ceasefire must be real and continuous. 3) Cambodia must genuinely cooperate in clearing landmines. The MFA also stated that Thailand had informed the UN Human Rights Office about Cambodia's alleged violations, emphasizing that Cambodia initiated the attack, causing Thai military and civilian casualties and forcing the closure of over 600 schools/hospitals.
summaryKh: អ្នកនាំពាក្យក្រសួងការបរទេសថៃបានប្រកាសពីលក្ខខណ្ឌ 3 សម្រាប់បទឈប់បាញ់ជាមួយកម្ពុជា៖ 1) កម្ពុជាត្រូវប្រកាសបទឈប់បាញ់មុន 2) បទឈប់បាញ់ត្រូវកើតឡើងពិតប្រាកដ និងបន្តជាប់លាប់ 3) កម្ពុជាត្រូវសហការក្នុងការដោះមីនដោយស្មោះត្រង់។ ក្រសួងការបរទេសក៏បានជូនដំណឹងដល់ការិយាល័យឧត្ដមស្នងការសិទ្ធិមនុស្សអង្គការសហប្រជាជាតិ (OHCHR) អំពីការរំលោភបំពានរបស់កម្ពុជា ដោយអះអាងថាកម្ពុជាជាអ្នកវាយប្រហារថៃមុន ដែលបណ្ដាលឱ្យមានអ្នកស្លាប់ និងរបួសទាំងទាហាន និងជនស៊ីវិល ហើយបង្ខំឱ្យសាលារៀន និងមន្ទីរពេទ្យជាង 600 កន្លែងបិទជាបណ្ដោះអាសន្ន។
summaryTh: โฆษกกระทรวงการต่างประเทศของไทยได้แถลงเงื่อนไข 3 ประการสำหรับการหยุดยิงกับกัมพูชา คือ 1) กัมพูชาต้องประกาศหยุดยิงก่อน 2) การหยุดยิงต้องเกิดขึ้นจริงและต่อเนื่อง 3) กัมพูชาต้องร่วมมือในการเก็บกู้ทุ่นระเบิดอย่างจริงใจ นอกจากนี้ กต. ยังแจ้งข้อกังวลเรื่องการละเมิดสิทธิมนุษยชนต่อสำนักงานข้าหลวงใหญ่เพื่อสิทธิมนุษยชนแห่งสหประชาชาติ (OHCHR) โดยระบุว่ากัมพูชาเป็นฝ่ายโจมตีไทยก่อน ทำให้มีผู้เสียชีวิตและบาดเจ็บ และโรงเรียน/สถานพยาบาลกว่า 600 แห่งต้องปิดทำการชั่วคราว

summary: The Ministry of Defense Spokesperson reports that the Thai military has secured 100% control of Ta Kwai Temple, although fighting persists in the immediate vicinity. Evacuation orders have been issued for the Khun Han and Phu Sing districts of Si Sa Ket, as Cambodian forces are accused of deliberately targeting civilian areas. The report also accuses Cambodia of spreading 'fake news' regarding the ongoing situation, including fabricating Thai casualty numbers using AI-generated images.

The report also accuses Cambodia of spreading 'fake news' regarding the ongoing situation, including fabricating Thai casualty numbers using AI-generated images.

summary: The spokesperson for China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs calls on Thailand and Cambodia to cease fire, protect civilians, and resolve the issue through direct negotiation, reaffirming China's active role in mediation. The Russian Embassy in Thailand also issued a statement urging both parties to adhere to the October ASEAN ceasefire declaration and officially refuted rumors circulating in Thai media regarding the involvement of Russian mercenaries fighting for Cambodia. France joined the calls for dialogue and restraint.
summaryEn: The spokesperson for China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs calls on Thailand and Cambodia to cease fire, protect civilians, and resolve the issue through direct negotiation, reaffirming China's active role in mediation. The Russian Embassy in Thailand also issued a statement urging both parties to adhere to the October ASEAN ceasefire declaration and officially refuted rumors circulating in Thai media regarding the involvement of Russian mercenaries fighting for Cambodia. summary: Mr. Peerapan Saleerathavipak, a key political figure, called on the government to impose severe measures to completely block military supply routes (ยุทธปัจจัย) to Cambodia. summary: The Immigration Bureau ordered all major Thai airports to tighten screening of Cambodian nationals entering visa-free and increase checks for foreign mercenaries, particularly from Eastern Europe and Northern Asia. This is due to concerns that foreigners might exploit the visa-free scheme to carry out operations that threaten Thai security.

summary: The Burapha Task Force continues its 8th day of border operations in Sa Kaeo province, involving the seizure of important areas, fire support, and drone strikes on Cambodian weapons depots. Two more Thai soldiers were injured. For public safety, over 21,500 civilians have been moved to temporary shelters. Additionally, the report notes that Cambodia has refused to allow Thai citizens in Poipet to return to Thailand via the Ban Khlong Luek border crossing for the fifth consecutive day.
summaryEn: The Burapha Task Force continues its 8th day of border operations in Sa Kaeo province, involving the seizure of important areas, fire support, and drone strikes on Cambodian weapons depots. Two more Thai soldiers were injured. For public safety, over 21,500 civilians have been moved to temporary shelters. Additionally, the report notes that Cambodia has refused to allow Thai citizens in Poipet to return to Thailand via the Ban Khlong Luek border crossing for the fifth consecutive day.

summary: China’s Foreign Ministry Spokesperson addressed the Thailand-Cambodia conflict, stating that as a friend, China is closely communicating with both sides to mediate, promote dialogue, and support direct negotiation and ASEAN's role. This marks the second time China has called for a constructive end to the conflict.
summaryEn: China’s Foreign Ministry Spokesperson, Guo Jiakun, addressed the Thailand-Cambodia border conflict during a regular press briefing, stating that as friends to both nations, China is offering one solution to the situation. The article also mentions related news such as US President Trump's threat to raise tariffs and the Russian Embassy's statement denying claims about Russian mercenaries fighting for Cambodia.

summary: The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) sent a formal letter to the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, condemning Cambodian missile attacks on civilian areas in Si Sa Ket that killed one Thai civilian. Thailand condemned the attacks as violations of international humanitarian law and invoked its inherent right to self-defense under Article 51 of the UN Charter, with military operations targeting only Cambodian military objectives.
summaryEn: The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) sent a formal letter to the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, condemning Cambodian missile attacks on civilian areas in Si Sa Ket that killed one Thai civilian. Thailand condemned the attacks as violations of international humanitarian law and invoked its inherent right to self-defense under Article 51 of the UN Charter, with military operations targeting only Cambodian military objectives.

summaryTh: กระทรวงการต่างประเทศของไทยได้ส่งหนังสืออย่างเป็นทางการถึงข้าหลวงใหญ่สิทธิมนุษยชนแห่งสหประชาชาติ ประณามการโจมตีด้วยขีปนาวุธของกัมพูชาต่อพื้นที่พลเรือนในจังหวัดศรีสะเกษ ซึ่งส่งผลให้พลเรือนชาวไทยเสียชีวิต 1 ราย ไทยประณามการโจมตีว่าเป็นการละเมิดกฎหมายมนุษยธรรมระหว่างประเทศ และอ้างสิทธิ์ในการป้องกันตนเองตามมาตรา 51 ของกฎบัตรสหประชาชาติ โดยยืนยันว่าปฏิบัติการทางทหารของไทยมุ่งเป้าไปที่เป้าหมายทางทหารของกัมพูชาเท่านั้น

summary: Cambodia reported that its civilian casualties from Thai attacks have increased to 12 killed and 74 injured. The report also claimed the arrest of a "mole" (spy/insider) who allegedly provided targeting information to Thailand, leading to the destruction of a bridge. (Note: Claims about casualty numbers and espionage are unilateral and unverified by Thailand).
summaryEn: Cambodia reported that its civilian casualties from Thai attacks have increased to 12 killed and 74 injured. (Note: Claims about casualty numbers and espionage are unilateral and unverified by Thailand).

summary: Lt. Gen. 'Serm. Maew' (a former military officer/columnist) advises the government to use Thailand's own strategy and international law to solve the border conflict, cautioning against becoming a victim of great power pressure. He specifically suggests China reconsider selling GAM-102LR rockets to Cambodia and expresses serious concern over Thai citizens allegedly being held hostage in Cambodia, stating it may violate international law.

summary: Thai police have intensified screening of foreigners, particularly in Nakhon Ratchasima's Phol Krang area, following intelligence reports suggesting possible infiltration by foreign mercenaries to target strategic locations. summary: Thai Army Region 2 (Northeast) reported on the Dec 15 border situation, stating Cambodia initiated heavy firing from 2:13 AM to 10:00 PM. Thai forces destroyed a Cambodian vehicle depot and used F-16s to bomb the Cambodian 371st Support Battalion HQ and damage the 795th Border Patrol Police HQ (80% damage). Thai forces are confirmed to be controlling the key areas, despite heavy clashes at Ta Kwai and Chong An Ma.

Thai forces are confirmed to be controlling the key areas, despite heavy clashes at Ta Kwai and Chong An Ma.

summary: The National Security Council (NSC) announced a resolution to intercept the shipment of oil and strategic materials intended for Cambodia. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is preparing to charter commercial flights to repatriate Thai citizens who are stranded in Cambodia. Furthermore, the NSC plans to propose increased compensation payments for injured and deceased individuals resulting from the conflict. The Permanent Secretary of Energy confirmed that oil exports to Laos are for economic development and are not being diverted to Cambodia.
summaryEn: The National Security Council (NSC) announced a resolution to intercept the shipment of oil and strategic materials intended for Cambodia. Furthermore, the NSC plans to propose increased compensation payments for injured and deceased individuals resulting from the conflict. The Permanent Secretary of Energy confirmed that oil exports to Laos are for economic development and are not being diverted to Cambodia.

summary: Thai Army Region 2 issued a summary of the Dec 15 border fighting, reporting heavy clashes at Ta Khwai and Chong An Ma. summary: An infographic summary of the border situation on December 16 reports clashes in several areas. It claims Thai forces successfully retook 100% control of the Chong Arn Ma pass, while Cambodian forces are strengthening defenses at Chong Bok. The Cambodian military is reportedly facing severe command problems at Chong Arn Ma and is expected to retreat to a secondary defense line. Both sides exchanged heavy fire, including Cambodia using BM-21 rockets against Ta Kwai Temple and Hill 350, prompting retaliation from Thailand.

summary: At the special ASEAN Foreign Ministers' meeting in Kuala Lumpur today (December 22), the Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs is presenting three non-negotiable conditions for a ceasefire: 1) Cambodia must officially announce and implement a genuine ceasefire first, 2) the ceasefire must be continuous and verified, and 3) Cambodia must cooperate in clearing landmines. Thailand maintains it is not the aggressor and will only stop military actions if these security guarantees are met.

Thailand maintains it is not the aggressor and will only stop military actions if these security guarantees are met.

summary: The Thai National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) issued a statement on December 16 expressing grave concern over the safety of soldiers and civilians near the border. summary: The Rak Chart (Love Nation) political party released a statement in English and French on December 16, strongly condemning Cambodia's indiscriminate attacks targeting innocent Thai civilians, schools, and hospitals as 'extremely inhumane' and unacceptable. The party called on the international community to consider the facts, stating Thailand has no intention of aggression and uses only the minimum necessary force to protect its sovereignty.

summary: An interview with the mother of Sgt. summaryEn: The Thai military's joint press center stated it is monitoring whether Cambodia will accept the 3 Thai ceasefire conditions, which include Cambodia having to announce a ceasefire first, a sustained cessation of violence, and cooperation in mine clearing. Cambodia's Ministry of Information denies this, stating the buildings are civilian infrastructure.

summary: The 2nd Army Region reported active clashes at Chong Sai Taku, resulting in a fire at a facility housing military drones and a scammer operation center. Thai forces seized key areas at Chong An Ma and Ta Kwai. Two Thai soldiers, Sgt. Maj. Samroeng Klangprakhon and Pvt. Panuphat Saosa, were confirmed killed in action. The military remains on high alert for drone attacks.

Thai forces seized key areas at Chong An Ma and Ta Kwai. Two Thai soldiers, Sgt. Maj. Samroeng Klangprakhon and Pvt. Panuphat Saosa, were confirmed killed in action. The military remains on high alert for drone attacks.

summary: The Royal Thai Army's First Army Area Command reported intensification of clashes in Sa Kaeo province. Sgt. Tensions in Poipet remain high following border closures and reports of smoke from local buildings.

Tensions in Poipet remain high following border closures and reports of smoke from local buildings.

summary: The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs held an international meeting with representatives from 58 countries to coordinate a crackdown on call center scammers. Notably, Cambodia did not attend the meeting despite the issue being prevalent in border areas. Mr. Sihasak Phuangketkeow confirmed that even without their attendance, Cambodia must eventually cooperate in these regional efforts.

Notably, Cambodia did not attend the meeting despite the issue being prevalent in border areas. Mr. Sihasak Phuangketkeow confirmed that even without their attendance, Cambodia must eventually cooperate in these regional efforts.

summary: Capt. Thammanoon Wanna of the Trat Marine Task Force stated that after 9 days of operation 'Trat Prab Porapak,' Thai forces have fully seized the 'Ban Sam Lang' area. He claimed Cambodian forces have been neutralized and no longer offer resistance. Current stats for the Trat area show 5 Thai soldiers injured, no deaths, and over 4,500 evacuees currently in shelters.

summary: Air Marshal Prapas Sonjaidee, Director of the Joint Press Information Center, stated Thailand's 3 requirements for peace: 1) Cambodia must announce a ceasefire first, 2) The ceasefire must be genuine and continuous, and 3) Cambodia must sincerely cooperate in landmine clearance along the border.
summaryEn: Air Marshal Prapas Sonjaidee, Director of the Joint Press Information Center, stated Thailand's 3 requirements for peace: 1) Cambodia must announce a ceasefire first, 2) The ceasefire must be genuine and continuous, and 3) Cambodia must sincerely cooperate in landmine clearance along the border.

summaryTh: พล.อ.อ. ประภาส สอนใจดี ผอ.ศูนย์แถลงข่าวร่วมฯ แถลงยืนยันเงื่อนไข 3 ข้อเพื่อสันติภาพ คือ 1. กัมพูชาต้องประกาศหยุดยิงก่อน 2. ต้องหยุดยิงจริงและต่อเนื่อง 3. ต้องร่วมมือเก็บกู้ทุ่นระเบิดอย่างจริงใจ

summary: Thai Navy's Marine Task Force in Trat reports that Cambodian forces have been 'incapacitated' after 8 days of the 'Trat Prab Porapak' operation. Following heavy naval and air strikes, Thai troops have recaptured Ban Sam Lang and are currently in full control of the situation with no counter-attacks reported.
summaryEn: Thai Navy's Marine Task Force in Trat reports that Cambodian forces have been 'incapacitated' after 8 days of the 'Trat Prab Porapak' operation. Following heavy naval and air strikes, Thai troops have recaptured Ban Sam Lang and are currently in full control of the situation with no counter-attacks reported.

summary: Army Region 2 summarized the situation from Dec 17, noting high-intensity clashes across 13 fronts in 4 provinces. At Prasat Ta Muen Thom, Cambodia has moved tanks to the front line. In Surin's Kap Choeng district, BM-21 rockets hit civilian homes, damaging roofs and property.

summary: Thai Marines have reportedly cleared Cambodian troops from Ban Nong Ri (also known as Ban Sam Lang) in Trat province. The operation was a joint effort with the Air Force to protect national sovereignty. Local rubber farmers express distress as the conflict prevents them from harvesting, leading to zero income.
summaryEn: Thai Marines have reportedly cleared Cambodian troops from Ban Nong Ri (also known as Ban Sam Lang) in Trat province. The operation was a joint effort with the Air Force to protect national sovereignty. Local rubber farmers express distress as the conflict prevents them from harvesting, leading to zero income.

summary: Civilian life in seven Thai border provinces has been severely disrupted by ongoing artillery and rocket fire. At least 15 Thai civilian deaths have been linked to the conflict, including indirect causes like accidents during mass evacuations and lack of medical access. Schools and hospitals remain closed in frontline zones, leaving hundreds of thousands displaced and economically devastated.
summaryEn: Civilian life in seven Thai border provinces has been severely disrupted by ongoing artillery and rocket fire. At least 15 Thai civilian deaths have been linked to the conflict, including indirect causes like accidents during mass evacuations and lack of medical access. Schools and hospitals remain closed in frontline zones, leaving hundreds of thousands displaced and economically devastated.

summaryTh: ชีวิตชาวบ้านใน 7 จังหวัดชายแดนไทยกำลังลำบากหนักจากการยิงปืนใหญ่และจรวด มีรายงานชาวบ้านไทยเสียชีวิตแล้วอย่างน้อย 15 ราย ซึ่งรวมถึงสาเหตุทางอ้อมอย่างอุบัติเหตุระหว่างอพยพและการเข้าไม่ถึงการรักษาพยาบาล ขณะนี้โรงเรียนและโรงพยาบาลในพื้นที่สู้รบยังต้องปิดทำการ

summary: The Thai military reports that the death toll for Thai soldiers has reached 21. Fierce combat is occurring at Hill 350 and Prasat Ta Kwai in Surin province, where the bodies of 2 soldiers remain trapped in the combat zone. Cambodia has reportedly fired over 100 BM-21 rockets into civilian agricultural areas in Sa Kaeo, burning 1,000 rai of land.

summary: Maj Gen Winthai Suvaree, Army spokesperson, dismissed Cambodian state TV reports alleging that Thai forces are conducting destructive warfare against civilian infrastructure and world heritage sites. He insisted that Thai operations are precision-targeted at military sites and that if heritage sites are damaged, it is because Cambodia is using them for military purposes, which forfeits their protected status. He added that the military has mostly achieved its objectives and the situation remains under control.

summary: Thai fighter jets dropped three bombs in Poipet, a major casino hub, on Thursday morning. The Royal Thai Air Force claimed the target was a 'logistics center' used by the Cambodian military to store rockets. However, the Cambodian Interior Ministry reported that the strike hit a warehouse and property, causing minor injuries to two civilians. The strike comes amid intensified border fighting that has killed at least 39 people on both sides this month.

summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) reported that Thailand has submitted a letter to the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights regarding Cambodia's closure of land borders, which prevents 5,000-6,000 Thai nationals in Poipet from returning home. The MFA reaffirmed its 3 conditions for a ceasefire: Cambodia must announce it first, the ceasefire must be real and continuous, and Cambodia must cooperate in demining. The Foreign Minister is set to attend a special ASEAN meeting in Kuala Lumpur on December 22 to discuss the situation.

summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) stated that Thailand is ready for the special ASEAN Foreign Ministers' meeting on December 22 in Kuala Lumpur. Deputy spokesperson Maratee Nalita Andamo emphasized that Thailand has three non-negotiable conditions for a ceasefire: 1) Cambodia must declare a ceasefire as the party that encroached on Thai territory, 2) the ceasefire must be real and continuous, and 3) Cambodia must show sincerity in demining operations. Foreign Minister Sihasak has briefed top diplomats from the EU, China, and the US on these positions.
summaryEn: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) stated that Thailand is ready for the special ASEAN Foreign Ministers' meeting on December 22 in Kuala Lumpur. Deputy spokesperson Maratee Nalita Andamo emphasized that Thailand has three non-negotiable conditions for a ceasefire: 1) Cambodia must declare a ceasefire as the party that encroached on Thai territory, 2) the ceasefire must be real and continuous, and 3) Cambodia must show sincerity in demining operations. Foreign Minister Sihasak has briefed top diplomats from the EU, China, and the US on these positions.

summary: Casualties are reported on both sides as fighting continues across four border provinces. The Thai Army is attempting to recover the bodies of two soldiers from Hill 350. Additionally, Thai F-16s reportedly struck a Cambodian military weapons depot in Poipet, which the military insists was a verified military target.

summary: Cambodian forces launched BM-21 rockets and heavy artillery at Pha Mo E-Daeng, Sisaket. Fighting is also reported in the Chong Jom and Ta Muen Thom areas.

summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has engaged in talks with Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow, expressing optimism that a ceasefire could be reached as early as Tuesday (Dec 23). This comes ahead of an ASEAN Foreign Ministers' meeting scheduled for December 22 in Kuala Lumpur, where the border crisis will be a primary focus. Thailand maintains it will not be pressured into a disadvantaged position but remains open to resolving the issue through established diplomatic frameworks.

summaryTh: นายมาร์โก รูบิโอ รมว.ต่างประเทศสหรัฐฯ ได้หารือกับนายสีหศักดิ์ พวงเกตุแก้ว รมว.ต่างประเทศของไทย โดยหวังว่าทั้งสองฝ่ายจะบรรลุข้อตกลงหยุดยิงได้เร็วที่สุดในวันอังคารหน้า ก่อนการประชุมรัฐมนตรีต่างประเทศอาเซียนในวันที่ 22 ธ.ค. ที่กรุงกัวลาลัมเปอร์ ซึ่งจะมีการหารือเรื่องวิกฤตชายแดนเป็นวาระสำคัญ โดยไทยย้ำว่าพร้อมชี้แจงและจะไม่ยอมให้ใครมากดดัน

summary: The Royal Thai Army (RTA) spokesperson, Maj. Gen. Winthai Suvaree, issued a statement condemning Cambodian forces for using BM-21 rocket launchers against civilian communities and housing near the border, calling it a violation of international humanitarian law. The conflict has reportedly affected 400,000 Thai civilians, with 23 deaths (mostly indirect) and 6 injuries. Additionally, the Burapha Task Force conducted a raid in Ban Nong Chan, seizing numerous 'mule' bank accounts and mobile phones used by cross-border scammer networks, which Thailand views as a military strategic target.

summary: Thai F-16 fighter jets reportedly conducted an airstrike on a casino building in Thmo Da, Pursat province, Cambodia, on December 20 at 11:20 AM. The building was allegedly used by Cambodian forces as an ammunition depot and a launch site for drones. While the Royal Thai Air Force has not officially confirmed the strike, reports suggest the operation was a response to escalating border tensions. The summary also notes that a Thai sailor was injured by a landmine in Trat recently.

summary: Rear Admiral Paratch Rattanachaiphan, Navy spokesperson, denied rumors that the Navy Commander-in-Chief was shot. However, he confirmed that a Cambodian sniper did target a local unit commander on the border before 'Operation Trat Prab Porapak' began. He described the act as a clear provocation and a violation of peaceful coexistence principles.

summary: Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow is leading a Thai delegation to a special ASEAN Foreign Ministers' meeting in Malaysia on December 22. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that Thailand seeks lasting peace but will not be 'pressured' or placed in a 'disadvantaged position' during the talks. This comes amid increasing international attention from the US and China regarding the border conflict.

summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated on December 19 (local time) that the United States is working hard to facilitate a new ceasefire agreement between Thailand and Cambodia by Monday or Tuesday (Dec 22-23). This comes ahead of a special ASEAN foreign ministers' meeting in Kuala Lumpur. Rubio mentioned a phone conversation with Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow and noted that previous written ceasefire commitments were not upheld due to mutual grievances. He emphasized that US diplomacy remains committed to ending the fighting despite recent escalations.

summaryTh: นายมาร์โค รูบิโอ รัฐมนตรีต่างประเทศสหรัฐฯ เผยว่าสหรัฐฯ กำลังเร่งผลักดันให้ไทยและกัมพูชาบรรลุข้อตกลงหยุดยิงครั้งใหม่ภายในวันจันทร์หรืออังคารที่จะถึงนี้ (22-23 ธ.ค.) ก่อนการประชุมรัฐมนตรีต่างประเทศอาเซียนที่กัวลาลัมเปอร์ โดยรูบิโอได้คุยทางโทรศัพท์กับนายสีหศักดิ์ รมว.ต่างประเทศของไทย และระบุว่าแม้ข้อตกลงเดิมจะถูกละเมิด แต่สหรัฐฯ ยังคงเชื่อมั่นในวิถีทางการทูตเพื่อยุติการสู้รบ

summary: As the conflict enters its 13th day, the Thai Army reported intense clashes in multiple areas including Hill 350 and various border passes. The Army condemned Cambodian forces for firing heavy weapons, including BM-21 rockets, indiscriminately into civilian residential areas and communities. Thai forces responded with counter-battery fire and air strikes on suspected BM-21 storage sites at Khao Pia Sabaek.
summaryEn: As the conflict enters its 13th day, the Thai Army reported intense clashes in multiple areas including Hill 350 and various border passes. The Army condemned Cambodian forces for firing heavy weapons, including BM-21 rockets, indiscriminately into civilian residential areas and communities. Thai forces responded with counter-battery fire and air strikes on suspected BM-21 storage sites at Khao Pia Sabaek.

summary: Army Region 2 summarized the border situation for Dec 20, 2025, confirming the loss of two soldiers at Hill 350. The bodies were retrieved after intense guarding by Cambodian forces using small arms and mines. A guard of honor ceremony is planned for Dec 21, 2025, to send the deceased to their respective hometowns for religious rites.
summaryEn: Army Region 2 summarized the border situation for Dec 20, 2025, confirming the loss of two soldiers at Hill 350. The bodies were retrieved after intense guarding by Cambodian forces using small arms and mines. A guard of honor ceremony is planned for Dec 21, 2025, to send the deceased to their respective hometowns for religious rites.

titleEn: Thailand Loses 2 Soldiers at Hill 350; Army Region 2 Sends Bodies to Hometowns Tomorrow (Dec 21, 2025)

summary: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim spoke with Thai PM Anutin Charnvirakul and Cambodian PM Hun Manet via phone. He urged both sides to use the Dec 22 ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Kuala Lumpur to find a peaceful and sustainable solution. International mediators including China and the US are also monitoring the situation closely.

summary: Cambodia has reportedly begun dismantling a controversial 300-meter breakwater/silt-trap barrier built into the sea near Trat province. This move comes after the Chanthaburi-Trat Border Defense Command issued an ultimatum that failure to remove the structure would result in Thailand cutting off the strategic supply route at the Koh Kong bridge. Thai authorities argued the structure could be used to expand maritime claims and was causing coastal erosion.

summary: Reports from the Chanthaburi and Trat Border Defense Command (CTBDC) state that Cambodian forces have agreed to dismantle a silt dam in the Ban Hat Lek area (Trat province) starting at 4:00 PM on December 20. The decision followed a Thai military warning that it would cut off logistics routes at the Koh Kong bridge if the dam was not removed. The move is seen as a tactical concession by Cambodia to avoid further escalation in the coastal sector. Other reports also mention Thai F-16s targeting a logistics bridge (O Rujick) connecting Siem Reap and Oddar Meanchey.

summary: The Ministry of Public Health updated that from December 7 to 21, 2025, 34 Thai citizens have died due to the conflict. summary: Army Region 1 reported that as of 6:00 PM on Dec 23, one Thai soldier has been killed and 7 civilians injured. Heavy fighting occurred at three points in Srakaew province. The Thai Burapha Task Force conducted strikes against two Cambodian military targets in Poipet, including a former call center building and a warehouse used for weapons. The report claims Cambodia used BM-21 rockets and heavy artillery against Thai civilian areas, damaging 14 houses and nearly 6,000 rai of farmland.

summary: As the conflict enters its 14th day, Second Army Region Commander Lt. Gen. Weerayut Raksilp announced that Thai forces have successfully seized and established control over 'Hill 350,' a strategic area near Prasat Ta Kwai in Surin province. Meanwhile, heavy artillery fire from the Thai side continues to support operations in the Preah Vihear sector (Kantharalak, Sisaket), where air activity and smoke plumes were observed near the mountain ridges. Residents remain in bunkers and are not yet allowed to return to their homes.

summary: Cambodia has started dismantling a controversial 300-meter breakwater built in Koh Kong province near the Trat border. The move followed a Thai ultimatum threatening to cut off access to the Koh Kong bridge, a key supply route. Although the Royal Thai Navy officially denied issuing a direct threat, security sources confirmed the pressure led to the removal. The structure was criticized for encroaching on maritime territory and causing coastal erosion in Thailand.

summary: Rear Adm Surasant Kongsiri, spokesman for the Thai Defence Ministry, stated that while Cambodian troops continued to fire rockets from BM-21 launchers at the Chub Ta Mok border pass in Surin early Sunday, the overall intensity of attacks has dropped significantly. However, a Thai marine lost a foot after stepping on a newly planted PMN-2 landmine in the Ban Nong Ree area of Trat province while on duty.
summaryEn: Rear Adm Surasant Kongsiri, spokesman for the Thai Defence Ministry, stated that while Cambodian troops continued to fire rockets from BM-21 launchers at the Chub Ta Mok border pass in Surin early Sunday, the overall intensity of attacks has dropped significantly. However, a Thai marine lost a foot after stepping on a newly planted PMN-2 landmine in the Ban Nong Ree area of Trat province while on duty.
summaryKh: អ្នកនាំពាក្យក្រសួងការពារជាតិថៃបានបញ្ជាក់ថា ទោះបីជាកម្ពុជានៅតែមានការបាញ់គ្រាប់រ៉ុក្កែត BM-21 ដាក់ច្រកជប់តាម៉ុក ក្នុងខេត្តសុរិន្ទ កាលពីព្រឹកថ្ងៃអាទិត្យក៏ដោយ ប៉ុន្តែជារួមភាពខ្លាំងនៃការវាយប្រហារបានថយចុះយ៉ាងខ្លាំង។ ទោះជាយ៉ាងណាក៏ដោយ មានហេតុការណ៍ទាហានជើងទឹកថៃម្នាក់ជាន់មីនប្រភេទ PMN-2 ដែលទើបនឹងយកមកដាក់ថ្មី ក្នុងតំបន់ភូមិណងរី ខេត្តត្រាត បណ្តាលឱ្យដាច់ជើងម្ខាង។
summaryTh: โฆษกกระทรวงกลาโหมระบุว่า แม้กัมพูชายังคงมีการยิงจรวด BM-21 ใส่ช่องจอม (ช่องต๊อก) ใน จ.สุรินทร์ เมื่อเช้าวันอาทิตย์ แต่ภาพรวมความรุนแรงของการโจมตีลดลงอย่างมาก อย่างไรก็ตาม เกิดเหตุทหารพรานนาวิกโยธินไทยเหยียบกับระเบิดชนิด PMN-2 ที่เพิ่งถูกนำมาวางใหม่ในพื้นที่บ้านหนองรี จ.ตราด จนทำให้สูญเสียเท้าหนึ่งข้าง

summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio called on Thailand and Cambodia to return to the peace agreement signed in October. The US expects both sides to reach a ceasefire by December 22 or 23. This push comes as the ASEAN Foreign Ministers held a special meeting in Malaysia. Meanwhile, the Thai military (TMAC) condemned Cambodia for laying new landmines, calling it a serious violation of international humanitarian law. Thai FM Sihasak reiterated Thailand's 3-point principle for any ceasefire to be effective.
summaryEn: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio called on Thailand and Cambodia to return to the peace agreement signed in October. The US expects both sides to reach a ceasefire by December 22 or 23. This push comes as the ASEAN Foreign Ministers held a special meeting in Malaysia. Meanwhile, the Thai military (TMAC) condemned Cambodia for laying new landmines, calling it a serious violation of international humanitarian law. Thai FM Sihasak reiterated Thailand's 3-point principle for any ceasefire to be effective.
summaryKh: លោក Marco Rubio រដ្ឋមន្ត្រីការបរទេសសហរដ្ឋអាមេរិក បានអំពាវនាវឱ្យថៃ និងកម្ពុជាត្រឡប់មកអនុវត្តតាមកិច្ចព្រមព្រៀងសន្តិភាពខែតុលាវិញ ដោយរំពឹងថានឹងមានការឈប់បាញ់គ្នានៅថ្ងៃទី 22 ឬ 23 ធ្នូនេះ ក្នុងអំឡុងពេលកិច្ចប្រជុំរដ្ឋមន្ត្រីការបរទេសអាស៊ាននៅម៉ាឡេស៊ី។ ទន្ទឹមនឹងនេះ មជ្ឈមណ្ឌលសកម្មភាពមីនជាតិថៃ (TMAC) បានថ្កោលទោសកម្ពុជាចំពោះការដាក់មីនថ្មី ដែលជាការរំលោភច្បាប់មនុស្សធម៌អន្តរជាតិយ៉ាងធ្ងន់ធ្ងរ។
summaryTh: นายมาร์โก รูบิโอ รมว.ต่างประเทศสหรัฐฯ เรียกร้องให้ไทยและกัมพูชากลับมาปฏิบัติตามข้อตกลงสันติภาพเดือน ต.ค. โดยคาดหวังให้มีการหยุดยิงภายในวันที่ 22 หรือ 23 ธ.ค. นี้ ท่ามกลางการประชุมรัฐมนตรีต่างประเทศอาเซียนที่มาเลเซีย ขณะที่ศูนย์ปฏิบัติการทุ่นระเบิดแห่งชาติ (TMAC) ประณามกัมพูชาที่วางทุ่นระเบิดใหม่ ซึ่งเป็นการละเมิดกฎหมายมนุษยธรรมอย่างร้ายแรง

summary: Army Region 2 released a summary of the situation on Dec 21, reporting continuous clashes in the Pha Mo E-Daeng, Huai Ta Maria, and Phu Makhuea areas. The military asserted that Thailand is exercising its right to self-defense under international law. It accused Cambodian forces of using historic sites as military bases and launch points for attacks, emphasizing that ancient monuments should not be used as battlegrounds.

summary: Reports suggest that the Cambodian government plans to use the special ASEAN Foreign Ministers' meeting to criticize Thailand. The allegations include claims that the Royal Thai Air Force used F-16 fighter jets to target non-military locations such as temples, historic sites, and schools, causing civilian casualties. Meanwhile, Thai officials like Anutin Charnvirakul have countered by stating Cambodia is the one spreading misinformation to the international community.
summaryEn: Reports suggest that the Cambodian government plans to use the special ASEAN Foreign Ministers' meeting to criticize Thailand. The allegations include claims that the Royal Thai Air Force used F-16 fighter jets to target non-military locations such as temples, historic sites, and schools, causing civilian casualties. Meanwhile, Thai officials like Anutin Charnvirakul have countered by stating Cambodia is the one spreading misinformation to the international community.

summary: Chatchai Bangchuad, Secretary-General of the National Security Council (NSC), stated following an NSC meeting chaired by Anutin Charnvirakul that Thailand maintains its stance regarding the ASEAN Special Foreign Ministers' meeting in Malaysia. summary: Tensions are high in Sa Kaeo province as Cambodian soldiers have taken positions on high-rise buildings near Ban Wang Mon in Aranyaprathet, just 1 kilometer from the Khlong Luek border crossing. Reports state that Cambodian troops have been firing intermittently from these buildings into Thai territory to create pressure. Thai security forces have tightened surveillance to protect the local economy and residents.

summary: Army Region 2 reports continued clashes at Pha Mo I Daeng and Huay Ta Maria. Cambodian forces utilized FPV suicide drones and heavy mortars. summary: Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow reported that the special ASEAN foreign ministers' meeting in Kuala Lumpur concluded without a ceasefire agreement. Thailand insists on addressing landmines, scam centers, and troop reductions. Both sides agreed to use the General Border Committee (GBC) framework, with Defense Ministers scheduled to meet in Chanthaburi on December 24.

Thailand insists on addressing landmines, scam centers, and troop reductions. Both sides agreed to use the General Border Committee (GBC) framework, with Defense Ministers scheduled to meet in Chanthaburi on December 24.

summary: Fighting intensified in Sa Kaeo province on December 22. Cambodian forces reportedly fired mortars into civilian areas in Khok Sung district, damaging a granary. At 11:30 AM, heavy weapons fire in Ta Phraya district resulted in the death of one Thai soldier. Over 167,000 civilians from four border districts (Aranyaprathet, Khlong Hat, Ta Phraya, and Khok Sung) have been evacuated to 848 temporary shelters. The Royal Thai Navy also confirmed control over the 'Thomoda' casino area in Trat province.

summary: The special ASEAN Foreign Ministers' meeting in Kuala Lumpur ended on December 22 without a ceasefire agreement between Thailand and Cambodia. Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow stated that Cambodia must initiate the ceasefire as the aggressor. Thailand set three conditions: a real and continuous ceasefire, sincerity in joint demining, and Cambodia taking responsibility for initial attacks. Both nations agreed to hold direct bilateral talks through the General Border Committee (GBC) on December 24 without a third-party mediator.
summaryEn: The special ASEAN Foreign Ministers' meeting in Kuala Lumpur ended on December 22 without a ceasefire agreement between Thailand and Cambodia. Thai Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow stated that Cambodia must initiate the ceasefire as the aggressor. Thailand set three conditions: a real and continuous ceasefire, sincerity in joint demining, and Cambodia taking responsibility for initial attacks. Both nations agreed to hold direct bilateral talks through the General Border Committee (GBC) on December 24 without a third-party mediator.

summary: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul refuted claims by US President-elect Donald Trump that Thailand initiated the conflict with Cambodia. The Thai Cabinet also approved guidelines for compensating victims of foreign military action, covering over 460,000 households in 7 border provinces. Additionally, a meeting between Thai and Cambodian defense officials is scheduled for December 24 to discuss the withdrawal of forces and a return to the Peace Declaration.
summaryEn: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul refuted claims by US President-elect Donald Trump that Thailand initiated the conflict with Cambodia. The Thai Cabinet also approved guidelines for compensating victims of foreign military action, covering over 460,000 households in 7 border provinces. Additionally, a meeting between Thai and Cambodian defense officials is scheduled for December 24 to discuss the withdrawal of forces and a return to the Peace Declaration.

summary: Burapha Force reports on the 15th day of the conflict in Sa Kaeo Province. Cambodian forces used heavy artillery, mortars, and BM-21 rockets (over 120 rounds in Ta Phraya district) to target Thai positions. The military confirmed the death of one Thai soldier, Sergeant First Class Kampanat Thongsaeng, during clashes at Ban Khlong Phaeng. Currently, 17,441 Thai civilians are sheltered in 40 evacuation centers across 4 border districts.

Currently, 17,441 Thai civilians are sheltered in 40 evacuation centers across 4 border districts.

summary: An analysis by the Strategic Policy Institute (ISP) suggests the ongoing conflict has cost Cambodia between $450 million and $650 million, leading to a GDP contraction of 1.3% to 1.6%. The report notes that investors are withdrawing, tourism is slumping, and the loss of remittances from 1.2 million Cambodian workers in Thailand is adding further strain. The World Bank warns of long-term economic consequences into next year.

summary: Fighting in Sa Kaeo province has entered its 15th day. Cambodian forces reportedly fired over 180 BM-21 rockets into three areas, including civilian locations in Khlong Phaeng. In response, the Royal Thai Air Force (RTAF) sent F-16 fighter jets to strike two specific military targets across the border. Over 17,000 Thai civilians have been evacuated to 40 temporary shelters across four districts in Sa Kaeo.

summary: Nationalist sentiment is rising as senior Cambodian monks have reportedly requested all temples across Cambodia to fly the national flag to show solidarity against Thailand. summary: The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) issued a statement following the Special ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Kuala Lumpur on Dec 22. Thailand laid out three essential conditions for a ceasefire: 1) Cambodia must declare the ceasefire first, 2) the ceasefire must be verifiable by military personnel on the ground, and 3) Cambodia must cooperate in joint demining. The MFA also confirmed that the General Border Committee (GBC) will meet on December 24, 2025, to discuss implementation details.
summaryEn: The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) issued a statement following the Special ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Kuala Lumpur on Dec 22. Thailand laid out three essential conditions for a ceasefire: 1) Cambodia must declare the ceasefire first, 2) the ceasefire must be verifiable by military personnel on the ground, and 3) Cambodia must cooperate in joint demining. The MFA also confirmed that the General Border Committee (GBC) will meet on December 24, 2025, to discuss implementation details.

summary: Chinese Special Envoy for Asian Affairs Deng Xijun visited Thailand and Cambodia from Dec 18-23 to mediate the border conflict. China expressed deep concern over casualties and displacement, urging an immediate ceasefire and supporting ASEAN's mediation and observer roles to restore regional stability.

summary: The Thai Ministry of Public Health (MOPH) reported that as of Dec 23, the total number of civilian deaths stands at 42. Of these, 41 are considered indirect deaths (likely related to stress or displacement), while one person died directly from a Cambodian attack. Thirteen people were injured yesterday in Srakaew due to BM-21 rocket fire. For safety, the MOPH has ordered the closure of 18 hospitals in the border zone.

summary: Citing reports from Cambodian media (Fresh News), the Cambodian Ministry of Interior stated that 21 civilians have died and 83 have been injured since Dec 7. Displacement has reached 544,685 people. The report mentions significant damage to infrastructure like schools, temples, and government offices due to Thai airstrikes (F-16s) and artillery. Both nations are looking toward the ASEAN-supported GBC meeting on Dec 24 for a potential ceasefire.

summaryTh: สื่อเขมรรายงานว่าคนบ้านเขาสังเวยสงครามไปแล้ว 21 ศพ เจ็บอีก 83 คน และมีคนหนีภัยสงครามกว่า 5 แสน 4 หมื่นคนแล้ว โรงเรียนวัดและที่ราชการพังเพียบจากการโดน F-16 กับปืนใหญ่ของไทยถล่ม ตอนนี้ทุกฝ่ายรอลุ้นผลการประชุมหยุดยิงพรุ่งนี้ (24 ธ.ค.)

summary: The Royal Thai Army reported a significant escalation in Sa Kaeo province where Cambodian forces allegedly fired nearly 200 BM-21 rockets. The attack resulted in 40 houses being damaged and 7 civilians injured. The Army stated that despite the upcoming GBC roadmap, tactical responses and counter-attacks remain necessary to defend Thai sovereignty and protect citizens from ongoing shelling.

The Army stated that despite the upcoming GBC roadmap, tactical responses and counter-attacks remain necessary to defend Thai sovereignty and protect citizens from ongoing shelling.

summary: Second Army Region reported that Thai forces targeted 18 Cambodian military sites at Pha Mor E-Dang and Chong Kan Ma using coordinated fire to eliminate threats. The Thai military maintains an advantage in positioning and operational control across four border provinces in the lower Northeast.

summary: A planned General Border Committee (GBC) meeting to negotiate a ceasefire is in doubt after Thailand rejected Cambodia's request to hold the talks in a neutral country like Malaysia. Cambodia cited security reasons for wanting a neutral venue.

summary: The General Border Committee (GBC) meeting is scheduled to take place from Dec 24-27 at Ban Pakard, Chanthaburi. Thailand has proposed three core conditions: 1) Cambodia must declare a ceasefire first, 2) The ceasefire must be real, continuous, and monitored, and 3) Cambodia must sincerely cooperate in landmine clearance. The Thai government emphasizes that any agreement depends on Cambodia's sincerity.

The Thai government emphasizes that any agreement depends on Cambodia's sincerity.

summary: Cambodia has dropped its demand to meet in Malaysia and agreed to meet in Chanthaburi. Thailand will present 5 points regarding Cambodia's violations of international law: 1) use and production of landmines, 2) using historical sites as military outposts, 3) firing heavy weapons from civilian areas, 4) using civilian buildings as weapon caches, and 5) using civilians as human shields.

summary: Secretariat-level officials from the General Border Committee (GBC) met at the Ban Phakkad checkpoint in Chanthaburi. The Thai side, led by Gen. The meeting is a precursor to a potential ministerial-level signing on December 27.

summary: The Thai Ministry of Defence expressed strong skepticism regarding Cambodia's commitment to peace as rocket attacks hit Si Sa Ket and Sa Kaeo just hours before GBC talks began. A Thai soldier was killed and four injured in Sa Kaeo on Dec 23, bringing the total Thai military death toll to 23. Thai officials stated that while negotiations proceed, Thailand must retaliate in self-defence.

summary: Military officials from both nations began four days of talks at the Ban Laem checkpoint in Chanthaburi. The initial secretary-level session on Wednesday lasted only 35 minutes. If these talks progress, defense ministers are expected to meet on Saturday (Dec 27) to finalize a ceasefire. Thailand is also raising concerns about Cambodia using ancient sites and civilian buildings for military positions.

Thailand is also raising concerns about Cambodia using ancient sites and civilian buildings for military positions.

summary: The Royal Thai Armed Forces Headquarters shared a formal letter from the Cambodian Ministry of Defense, signed by Tea Seiha, addressed to the Thai Defense Minister. The letter expresses Cambodia's intent to negotiate a ceasefire according to the Kuala Lumpur Joint Statement and suggests utilizing the ASEAN Observer Team (AOT) to verify compliance. However, Thai media noted that as of the publication time, official Cambodian channels had not yet posted this letter publicly.

summary: Cambodia dropped its demand to hold border talks in a neutral third country (Malaysia) and sent representatives to Chanthaburi, Thailand. Thailand's Ministry of Defence reiterated its three core conditions: Cambodia must stop firing first, the ceasefire must be verifiable by observers, and Cambodia must cooperate in demining efforts. The atmosphere is described as rigid.

The atmosphere is described as rigid.

summary: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul addressed the Indian government's protest regarding the Thai military's destruction of a Hindu statue at the Chong An Ma border pass. He emphasized that the loss of a religious statue, which was built on Thai soil by Cambodia, cannot be compared to the loss of lives and limbs suffered by Thai soldiers defending the border. He also commented on the GBC (General Border Committee) meeting in Chanthaburi, describing the 30-minute session on Dec 24 as just a preliminary greeting and that the process will take several more days.

summary: The French Embassy in Phnom Penh has expanded its travel alert for French citizens in Cambodia. An 'orange zone' (travel only if necessary) has been added, extending 30 kilometers south of the existing 'red zone' (no travel) which already covers a 50-kilometer radius from the Thai border. The warning includes Battambang, Banteay Meanchey, and Preah Vihear provinces. This move follows reports from Cambodia claiming Thai T-50TH aircraft launched strikes in Battambang's Banan District.

summary: The 1st Army Region reported that on the 18th day of the conflict (Dec 25), Cambodian forces fired 40 BM-21 rockets into a civilian residential area at Ban Khlong Phaeng, Ta Phraya District, Sa Kaeo. The attack damaged houses, utilities, and farmland. Currently, 17,913 Thai civilians from four border districts have been evacuated to 40 temporary shelters. The military stated this intentional attack on civilians violates international humanitarian law.
summaryEn: The 1st Army Region reported that on the 18th day of the conflict (Dec 25), Cambodian forces fired 40 BM-21 rockets into a civilian residential area at Ban Khlong Phaeng, Ta Phraya District, Sa Kaeo. The attack damaged houses, utilities, and farmland. Currently, 17,913 Thai civilians from four border districts have been evacuated to 40 temporary shelters. The military stated this intentional attack on civilians violates international humanitarian law.

summary: Officials at the General Border Committee (GBC) meeting in Chanthaburi have drafted a ceasefire agreement set for December 27, 2025. Both sides will monitor the situation for 72 hours while waiting for a final decision from the Thai National Security Council.
summaryEn: The United States and Russia have called for an immediate end to the violence as clashes enter their third week. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke with PM Hun Manet to reaffirm the US's readiness to facilitate peace. Thai and Cambodian defense ministers are expected to meet in Chanthaburi this Saturday to discuss a formal 72-hour ceasefire monitoring agreement.

summary: ACM Prapas Sornjaidee, director of the Joint Thai-Cambodian Situation Briefing Centre, stated that Thai military operations are 'strictly defensive' under Article 51 of the UN Charter. Thailand maintains it has no intention of occupying Cambodian territory. Meanwhile, the Army Chief of Staff noted that most military objectives have been achieved, but Thailand insists Cambodia must be the one to formally declare a ceasefire first as they initiated the conflict.

summary: The Thai Army Region 2 announced that it has regained control over 90% of the disputed sovereign territory. It successfully seized 'Hill 225,' a strategic point near Prasat Ta Kwai that connects to Hill 350. However, a combat engineer sustained a serious injury, losing his left leg to a landmine near the temple, making him the 9th soldier to suffer such an injury in this conflict. The army accuses Cambodia of lacking the intent to stop the conflict, citing continued BM-21 rocket fire into Sa Kaeo.

summary: The 2nd Army Region reported that the situation at the Thai-Cambodian border remains tense on December 25-26. Cambodian forces have been using artillery and BM-21 rockets to pressure Thai positions, particularly at Chong Sai Taku in Buriram. Thai forces have responded with proportional artillery fire. Despite the attacks, the military confirms that Thailand maintains full control over all primary strategic areas.

summary: As of December 26, the third day of General Border Committee (GBC) secretariat talks in Chanthaburi ended without a consensus. Cambodia continues to reject Thailand's three core proposals: a prior formal declaration of ceasefire by Cambodia, a genuine and continuous cessation of fire, and cooperation on demining. The atmosphere is described as very tense, while an ASEAN Observer Team (AOT) from Malaysia continues to monitor the situation.

Cambodia continues to reject Thailand's three core proposals: a prior formal declaration of ceasefire by Cambodia, a genuine and continuous cessation of fire, and cooperation on demining. The atmosphere is described as very tense, while an ASEAN Observer Team (AOT) from Malaysia continues to monitor the situation.

summary: Army Region 2 summarized border tension on December 26, noting that Cambodian forces fired BM-21 multiple rocket launchers from the Preah Vihear temple area into Thailand's Phu Ma Khuea. One Thai soldier was injured during artillery exchanges in the Phu Ma Khuea–Don Ao area. Additionally, two soldiers were injured by PMN-2 anti-personnel landmines during clearing operations at Prasat Ta Kwai. Cambodian forces also shelled near Prasat Ta Muen Thom and Chong Sai Taku.
summaryEn: Army Region 2 summarized border tension on December 26, noting that Cambodian forces fired BM-21 multiple rocket launchers from the Preah Vihear temple area into Thailand's Phu Ma Khuea. One Thai soldier was injured during artillery exchanges in the Phu Ma Khuea–Don Ao area. Additionally, two soldiers were injured by PMN-2 anti-personnel landmines during clearing operations at Prasat Ta Kwai. Cambodian forces also shelled near Prasat Ta Muen Thom and Chong Sai Taku.

summary: The Government Savings Bank (GSB) has announced special measures to assist those affected by the Thailand-Cambodia border conflict. Debt will be cancelled for soldiers and border patrol police killed in action since December 7, 2025. Additionally, civilians forced to evacuate or who have lost income due to the fighting are eligible for a 3-month debt moratorium with no interest charged.
summaryEn: The Government Savings Bank (GSB) has announced special measures to assist those affected by the Thailand-Cambodia border conflict. Debt will be cancelled for soldiers and border patrol police killed in action since December 7, 2025. Additionally, civilians forced to evacuate or who have lost income due to the fighting are eligible for a 3-month debt moratorium with no interest charged.

summary: The Department of Foreign Trade reported that border trade between Thailand and Cambodia has suffered a loss of approximately 72 billion baht over the first 11 months of 2025. This decline is largely attributed to the persistent border conflict and restricted movement at various checkpoints. Trade with Myanmar is also facing significant challenges due to regional instability.

summary: Secretarial-level talks for the Thailand–Cambodia General Border Committee (GBC) concluded in Chanthaburi on December 26. The two sides have reached a '6th draft' agreement which is now being reviewed by the Thai National Security Council (NSC). If approved, a formal signing ceremony between Thai Defense Minister Gen Natthaphon Narkphanit and Cambodian Defense Minister Gen Tea Seiha is expected on December 27, aimed at initiating a 72-hour ceasefire.

summary: Army Region 1 reported that 3 Thai soldiers were killed on December 26 during a strategic operation to secure territory in Sa Kaeo province. The fallen soldiers were identified as Sergeant First Class Pongsakorn Nakthongdee, Private Patiphat Sornpradit, and Private Tiwtawan Phonyiam. Fighting was most intense at Ban Nong Chan, where Cambodian forces used heavy artillery. Currently, 18,188 Thai civilians are taking refuge in 40 temporary shelters across four districts in Sa Kaeo.

summary: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul confirmed that the National Security Council has authorized the Defense Minister to sign a ceasefire agreement in Chanthaburi on Saturday. However, hostilities continued late Friday as a Cambodian rocket attack in Surin province killed three Thai soldiers and injured 17 others. Anutin emphasized that while Thailand agrees to the truce, it will not accept returning to pre-conflict positions in secured areas, stating Thailand 'cannot retreat'.

However, hostilities continued late Friday as a Cambodian rocket attack in Surin province killed three Thai soldiers and injured 17 others. Anutin emphasized that while Thailand agrees to the truce, it will not accept returning to pre-conflict positions in secured areas, stating Thailand 'cannot retreat'.

summary: Authorities in Ubon Ratchathani, Surin, and Sa Kaeo have issued urgent warnings for residents to remain in bunkers or evacuation centers until a projected ceasefire at 12:00 PM on Saturday, Dec 27. Officials fear that Cambodian forces may launch heavy attacks or long-range artillery strikes in the final hours leading up to the truce in an attempt to regain lost strategic positions. Local defense volunteers have been told to dim lights and watch for unidentified drones.

Officials fear that Cambodian forces may launch heavy attacks or long-range artillery strikes in the final hours leading up to the truce in an attempt to regain lost strategic positions. Local defense volunteers have been told to dim lights and watch for unidentified drones.
